request.system:
You are a helpful customer support assistant for Hawa Home, a smart home brand that sells the Hawa Aero ceiling fan, the Hawa Lock S1 smart door lock and the Hawa Pure RO water purifier.

Answer the customer's question. You can use the tools to control their devices.

The customer's devices:
- fan-living: Living room fan (Hawa Aero, room: living room)
- fan-bedroom: Bedroom fan (Hawa Aero, room: bedroom)
- lock-main: Main door lock (Hawa Lock S1, room: main door)
- purifier-kitchen: Kitchen purifier (Hawa Pure RO, room: kitchen)

Some manual sections that may help:
[pure/filters#filter-life-and-replacement-schedule] Filters: Filter Life and Replacement Schedule
The Pure RO has 4 replaceable parts. Replace each one at the time or volume below, whichever
comes first:
- Sediment filter: every 6 months or 3,000 litres
- Activated carbon filter: every 12 months or 6,000 litres
- RO membrane: every 24 months or 8,000 litres
- UV lamp: every 12 months
The app shows remaining filter life as a percentage. The FILTER LED on the purifier is green
above 10%, turns amber at 10% or below, and turns red at 0%. At 0% the purifier stops
dispensing water to protect water quality, until the filter is replaced.

[pure/troubleshooting#error-codes] Troubleshooting: Error Codes
- E1: low inlet water pressure (below 0.4 kg/cm2). Check the inlet valve and water supply.
- E2: tank full sensor fault. Switch off for 1 minute and on again; if it repeats, raise a ticket.
- E3: UV lamp failure. The purifier stops dispensing until the UV lamp is replaced by a technician.
- E4: leakage detected. The purifier closes the inlet valve automatically. Switch it off, wipe
  the area dry and raise a service ticket.
- E5: filter life 0%. Replace the filter and reset the counter.

[pure/filters#how-to-replace-filters] Filters: How to Replace Filters
Use only genuine Hawa filters. The filter service kit is HP-FK-02 (sediment + carbon) and the
membrane kit is HP-MB-08. Using non-genuine filters voids the warranty.
1. Switch off the purifier and close the inlet water valve.
2. Open the front cover and twist the old filter anticlockwise to remove it.
3. Insert the new filter and twist clockwise until it clicks.
4. Open the inlet valve and switch the purifier on.
5. Reset the filter counter: press and hold the FILTER button for 5 seconds until you hear
   2 beeps (or use the app: Pure RO > Filters > Reset).
6. Drain the first 2 full tanks of water after a filter change; do not drink it.
RO membrane and UV lamp replacement must be done by a Hawa technician.

[lock/batteries#low-battery-warning] Batteries: Low Battery Warning
The Lock S1 runs on 8 x AA alkaline batteries (1.5 V). Typical battery life is about 10 months
with 10 unlocks a day. Do not use rechargeable 1.2 V batteries; the lock will show low battery
too early.
- At 20% battery: the lock beeps 3 times after every unlock and the keypad shows a red battery
  icon. The app sends a "Low battery" notification.
- At 10% battery: the lock still works for about 50 more unlocks. Replace batteries now.
- At 5% battery: fingerprint and app unlock are disabled to save power; only PIN, card and
  mechanical key work.
Replace all 8 batteries at the same time. Your users and settings are not lost when you
change batteries.

messages.content: How much filter life is left in my kitchen purifier?

tools.name: get_device_status
tools.description: Get the live status of one of the user's devices (online, speed, battery, filter life).

tools.name: set_fan_speed
tools.description: Set the speed of a Hawa Aero fan. Speed must be an integer from 1 to 5.

tools.name: check_warranty
tools.description: Check warranty status for a product serial number like HA-AERO-1001.

tools.name: create_service_ticket
tools.description: Raise a service ticket for a technician visit. Needs the device, a short issue description and the user's 10-digit Indian mobile number.

response.text:
Your kitchen purifier currently has **8%** filter life remaining. 

Since the filter life is at 10% or below, your purifier's FILTER LED should be amber, and you'll want to plan on replacing the filters soon. Once it reaches 0%, the purifier will stop dispensing water until the filter is replaced. 

The filter service kit for your Hawa Pure RO (model HP-FK-02) includes the sediment and activated carbon filters. Let me know if you need help ordering replacement filters or if you have any questions about replacing them!
